name: sandbox
description: The per-environment proxy Worker sitting in front of each team's Supabase project

scripts.cf:deploy:staging: DEPLOY_ENV=staging with-env -c 'pnpm --filter @devdogsuga/devtools run cli:no-env deploy require-token && wrangler deploy -e staging ${DEPLOY_SECRETS_FILE:+--secrets-file $DEPLOY_SECRETS_FILE} --var PLATFORM_REST_URL:$REST_URL'
scripts.cf:deploy:production: DEPLOY_ENV=production with-env -c 'pnpm --filter @devdogsuga/devtools run cli:no-env deploy require-token && wrangler deploy -e production ${DEPLOY_SECRETS_FILE:+--secrets-file $DEPLOY_SECRETS_FILE} --var PLATFORM_REST_URL:$REST_URL'
